description: A UI end-to-end test fails intermittently on timing, and passes on retry.

input.pytest_output:
tests/e2e/test_checkout.py::test_apply_promo_then_pay FAILED (attempt 1)

    playwright._impl._api_types.TimeoutError: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.
    waiting for selector "#order-confirmation" to be visible

tests/e2e/test_checkout.py::test_apply_promo_then_pay PASSED (attempt 2, on retry)

Note: this same test passed on the previous CI run and passes locally. No app or test code changed in this PR.
input.code_context: The checkout confirmation element sometimes renders slightly after the 5s wait under CI load. The assertion and the app behaviour are otherwise correct; the failure did not reproduce on retry.

expected.root_cause: An intermittent timing/rendering issue under CI load, not a code defect: the confirmation element renders just after the 5s wait and the test passes on retry. The fix is a more robust wait, not an application change.
